questions.question: What is AWS Lambda?
questions.reference_answer: AWS Lambda lets you run code without provisioning or managing servers. You pay only for the compute time you consume, there is no charge when your code is not running, and you can run code for virtually any application or backend service with zero administration.
questions.answer:
**Answer:**
AWS Lambda is a serverless service that lets you run code without provisioning, managing, or thinking about servers. You pay only for the compute time you consume, with no charge when your code is not running. It provides zero administration, allowing you to run code for virtually any type of application or backend service by simply uploading your code, which Lambda then takes care of running and scaling with high availability. You can set it up to run automatically from other AWS services or call it directly from a web or mobile app.
